headline: Committee to discuss zoning use regulation amendment (Paper 327-26) and new assistant department head salary schedule (Paper 415-26).
summary: The committee will discuss amending the city's use regulations in Title 12.12.030 and adding a new assistant department head salary schedule under Title 2, Chapter 24. Members will also discuss drafting new zoning papers related to Motel-Hotel, Supermarket, and Restaurant use regulations.
items: Paper 327-26: Amend MCC 12.12.030 Use Regulations, sponsored by Ari Taylor, Stephen Winslow and Ryan O'Malley
Paper 415-26: Amend MCC Title 2, Chapter 24 to add Section .075 Assistant Department Head Salary Schedule, sponsored by Stephen Winslow

Discussion of drafting new papers related to Papers 335, 335A, and 337 covering use regulation updates and dimensional controls for Title 12, possibly including Motel-Hotel, Supermarket, and Restaurant zoning
location: Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
